question.prompt: What is the ones digit of \[\begin{align*} & 222,222 - 22,222 - 2,222 \\ &- 222 - 22 - 2? \end{align*}\]

solutions.explanation: The five numbers being subtracted each end in \(2\). Their ones digits total \(5\cdot2=10\), which carries into the tens column and leaves \(0\) in the ones column of their sum. Subtracting this sum from \(222,222\) therefore gives \(2-0=2\) in the ones column. The answer is \(\boxed{2}\), choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
solutions.title: Combine the ones digits
